title: Chapter 140 Making A Fuss About The Agreement
content:
Chapter 140 Making A Fuss About The Agreement

When I came to the door, I happened to meet Ayub.

"Lord Lord!"

Ayub and others bowed.

Wang Shuo glanced over a few people and found that their levels had improved.

"Haha, you're not injured!" Wang Shuo strode over and punched Ayub, "My body has become much stronger again!"

"How can these little skeletons hurt me!" Ayub showed off his arms confidently.

"By the way, how is your understanding of the formation?" Wang Shuo thought of the "One-Word Long Snake Formation" formation experience he gave him.

"Back to the lord, I haven't fully understood it yet. It may take a few days." Ayub was a little ashamed and his old face turned red.

If he was asked to go into battle to kill the enemy, he would definitely rush forward, but if he was asked to study, this would be a bit difficult for him.

"Don't be in a hurry, take your time." Wang Shuo saw his expression and probably knew what he was thinking.

Don't force anything, just make it happen naturally.

Wang Shuo planned to go to the ancient battlefield. Before leaving, he called Duan Wenxi and Suo Yong to explain a few things about territory construction.

They were told to establish the blacksmith shop, carpentry shop and tailor shop as soon as possible, and the production of military supplies must be given top priority.

Now Wang Shuo no longer needs to make city wall bricks.

Yan Fujie is already able to stand alone.

Wang Shuo found Xiao Laoteng again and talked to him about the previous agreement.

Since there are no ready-made city wall bricks, all the masons are seizing the time to make brick embryos.

At this moment, Xiao Laoteng was a little idle, hiding in the room drinking tea.

When he saw Wang Shuo coming, he was a little angry, because there was no one to learn how to draw defensive runes with him, so the agreement between them could not be fulfilled.

But thinking that this trip can earn 200,000 gold coins, even if it takes an extra day, it will be a bloody profit.

Thinking of this, his mood immediately improved.

However, Wang Shuo was just the opposite. When he saw Xiao Laoteng, Wang Shuo became furious.

"Master Architect, I am going on a long trip. I will pay you a deposit of 10,000 gold coins first. The remaining gold coins include the money to buy city wall bricks. I will give it to you after our agreement is completed!" Wang Shuo smiled half-heartedly. said.

"this……"

Wang Shuo then said: "As you can see, my village is very small and was completely destroyed. Now I have to buy energy crystals to pay off my debt!"

"Okay then!" Xiao Laoteng opened his mouth, but hesitated. After a while, he still said softly, "It's just that, Lord, I don't know when I will let them continue to practice drawing defensive runes!"

Wang Shuo stood at the door and smiled: "Master Architect, you also know that my territory is in danger now. This city wall brick is nothing more than a life-saving straw. At present, the most important thing is the brick embryo."

Wang Shuo turned around, looked at the sky, and said casually: "Let's wait until the brick embryo is finished!"

After handing Xiao Laoteng 1,000 energy crystals, Wang Shuo led his men into the ancient battlefield.

"Wang Shuo, long time no see. You are getting stronger and stronger now!"

Zhao Bangde smiled happily when he saw the dozen or so people led by Wang Shuo.

"Old Zhao, please stop making fun of me!" Wang Shuo looked back at his troops with a happy face.

I was secretly proud of myself.

"Tell you good news." Zhao Bangde approached Wang Shuo pretending to be mysterious and whispered.

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and asked suspiciously: "What's the good news?"
